sentences.text:
Renukaji Project & Another vs . Kirpa Ram & Others on 17 July,
2023
Author: Virender Singh

Bench: Virender Singh
Renukaji Project & Another Vs. Kirpa Ram & Others .

Present: Mr. Vivek Negi, Advocate, for the appellants/
non-applicants.
Mr. Pawan K. Sharma, Advocate for respondents No1(a) to 1(e), 2, 3(a) to 3(f), 5 to 8.

Mr. H.S. Rawat, Additional Advocate General, for respondent No.17.
Cmp No. 8691 of 2023.

By way of the present application, the applicants, have sought their impleadment in the present
case, in place of respondent No.1 Kirpa Ram, who, as per the application, has expired on 4.3.2022.
Perusal of the record shows that appellants have filed the appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act against the award dated 7.4.2017, passed by learned District Judge, Sirmaur at Nahan.
The said appeal was decided by this Court vide judgment dated 9.4.2021, with a batch of appeals, lead case whereof are RFA No.68 of 2015.
In order to substantiate their prayer, the applicants have relied upon the legal heir certificate issued by the competent authority.

Considering the factual position and in view of the law laid down by this Court in Collector Land Acquisition NHPC versus Khewa Ram & Others, Latest HLJ 2007 (HP), 270, the application is allowed and the .
applicants are ordered to be brought on record, as respondents 1(a) to 1(e).

The present application has been moved by the respondents/applicants No.1(a) Rajesh Kumar, 1(b)
Sharma Nand, 1(c) Lakshmi Devi, 1(d) Santoshi Devi, 1(e) Saraswati @ Surashwati Devi, applicant No.2 Jodha Ram, 3(a) Sunil Sharma, 3(b) Naveen Sharma, 3(c) Mamta Devi, 3(d) Ambika, 3(e)
Sonika Devi, applicant No.5 Gopal Singh @ Ram Gopal, applicant No.6 Satya, applicant No.7 Sumitra @ Savitri and applicant No.8 Kamla, for release of the remaining amount of compensation,
falling in their shares, in the above titled case.

In view of the no objection made by learned counsel appearing for the appellants/non-applicants,
the amount of compensation, falling in the shares of the applicants, along with upto date interest, is ordered to be released to the them, by remitting the same to their Bank accounts, particulars whereof find mentioned in para 8 of the application.
The application stands disposed of.
(Virender Singh) Judge July 17, 2023(ps)
